 Filipino Artists Who Are Big in Southeast Asia 
 by Carina Dimaculangan 
 on Nov 15, 2026 | 08:00 PM Edited: 
 Nov 13, 2026 | 05:30 PM 
 Filipino Artists Who Are Big in Southeast Asia 
 Filipino pop used to travel mainly through TV and family networks. In the last two years it has also been traveling as a concert itinerary, with paid tickets in Singapore, Malaysia and other neighboring capitals.
 SB19 is the clearest example. The group's Simula at Wakas World Tour included a date at the Arena at Expo in Singapore on Aug. 24, 2025. This year the group has also been attached to the official ASEAN 2026 song, "Together in Motion," a host-year assignment that puts a P-pop act on a regional stage without needing a translation.
 BINI has followed a similar path, then gone farther. The eight-member group became the first Filipino act to perform at Coachella, on April 21, 2026, in Los Angeles, after a Biniverse world tour in 2025 and a stream count that concert presenters have placed in the billions for songs such as "Cherry On Top." Closer to home, the Signals World Tour listed a Singapore date at the Arena at Expo on Oct. 25, 2026. A HYBE executive, speaking about Southeast Asia, has pointed to BINI and SB19 as Philippine acts with a real local following in the region.
 Ben&Ben have been working the same circuit from a different lane, folk-pop rather than idol pop. The band has returned to Singapore as part of its Traveller Across Dimensions tour, again at a large Expo hall, a sign that the Southeast Asian live market is buying Filipino tickets beyond a single genre.
 The point is not that every Filipino celebrity is now a regional star. It is that a handful of acts now sell rooms in neighboring countries the way visiting K-pop and Western tours do, and that the host year for ASEAN gives those names a second kind of exposure, on official stages as well as on ticketed ones. If you want a simple test, it is this: can the act fill a hall in Singapore without a hometown crowd flying in? For these three, the calendars say yes.
 Catalogs and tour dates keep moving. Treat any 2027 show as a listing to recheck on the official page before you buy.
